subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493 DR.
source_quote: The session occurs on the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493 DR.

subject: chasme count
fact: Four chasme demons are present in the cavern above the prisoners' tower.
source_quote: four chasme and two vrock

subject: travel to Sloobludop
fact: Sloobludop is approximately eight days away via the Darklake.
source_quote: the town of Sloopdopblop is just eight days away

subject: Velkynvelve elevation
fact: Velkynvelve sits 100 feet above the cavern floor.
source_quote: Drow outpost was 100' in the sky

subject: silver candlestick value
fact: The silver candlesticks flanking the Lolth altar are worth 25 gp each.
source_quote: a pair of heavy silver candlesticks worth 25 gp each

subject: elapsed time
fact: An hour passes between two events in the session.
source_quote: An hour later

subject: Pudding King transformation
fact: The Pudding King transforms into a sentient, telepathic ooze, revealing he has embraced his connection to Juiblex.
source_quote: The Pudding King transforms into a sentient, telepathic ooze, revealing he has embraced his connection to Juiblex.

subject: Bag of Holding usage
fact: The Bag of Holding can temporarily deprive the Pudding King of an action, but a sentient ooze can 'ooze out' of it.
source_quote: the DM rules that while a normal creature could be sealed in the bag, an ooze could 'ooze out' of it.

subject: Pudding King's slime wave
fact: The Pudding King unleashes a slime wave, forcing Zalthir, Thorin, Daz, and Grygum to make dexterity saving throws.
source_quote: The Pudding King unleashes a slime wave, forcing Zalthir, Thorin, Daz, and Grygum to make dexterity saving throws.

subject: Zalthir's acid damage reduction
fact: Zalthir takes eleven points of acid damage, using Stone Skin to reduce it to five.
source_quote: Zalthir takes eleven points of acid damage, using Stone Skin to reduce it to five.

subject: Daz's Magic Missile damage
fact: Daz casts Magic Missile at the Pudding King, dealing six points of damage.
source_quote: Daz casts Magic Missile at the Pudding King, dealing six points of damage.

subject: Prince Livid's psychic blast
fact: Prince Livid attacks Zalthir with a psychic blast, dealing fourteen points of damage reduced to seven by a successful intelligence saving throw.
source_quote: Prince Livid attacks Zalthir with a psychic blast, dealing fourteen points of damage reduced to seven by a successful intelligence saving throw.

subject: Grygum's Guiding Bolt
fact: Grygum casts Guiding Bolt at the Pudding King, but it misses.
source_quote: Grygum casts Guiding Bolt at the Pudding King, but it misses.

subject: Glabbagool's reaction
fact: Glabbagool reacts to having both Zalthir and the Pudding King inside him, saying 'this tickles'.
source_quote: Glabbagool reacts to having both Zalthir and the Pudding King inside him, saying 'this tickles'.

subject: Thorin's dart damage
fact: Thorin attacks with darts, dealing six points of piercing damage.
source_quote: Thorin attacks with darts, dealing six points of piercing damage.

subject: Dawnbringer radiant damage
fact: Thorin attacks the correct target (the Pudding King in Glabbagool's body) with Dawnbringer, dealing twelve points of radiant damage.
source_quote: Thorin attacks the correct target (the Pudding King in Glabbagool's body) with Dawnbringer, dealing twelve points of radiant damage.

subject: Daz's third-level Magic Missile
fact: Daz casts a third-level Magic Missile at the Pudding King, dealing twenty points of damage.
source_quote: Daz casts a third-level Magic Missile at the Pudding King, dealing twenty points of damage.

subject: Grygum's Inflict Wounds
fact: Grygum casts Inflict Wounds on the Pudding King, dealing twenty-three points of damage.
source_quote: Grygum casts Inflict Wounds on the Pudding King, dealing twenty-three points of damage.

subject: Daz's Fireball
fact: Daz casts Fireball, dealing twenty-nine points of damage to both Prince Livid and Princess Ebonmire.
source_quote: Daz casts Fireball, dealing twenty-nine points of damage to both Prince Livid and Princess Ebonmire.

subject: Princess Ebonmire's charge
fact: Princess Ebonmire charges at Thorin.
source_quote: Princess Ebonmire charges at Thorin.

subject: Prince Livid's psychic attack
fact: Prince Livid uses a psychic attack on Daz, dealing five points of damage.
source_quote: Prince Livid uses a psychic attack on Daz, dealing five points of damage.

subject: Grygum's Inflict Wounds on Princess Ebonmire
fact: Grygum casts Inflict Wounds on Princess Ebonmire, dealing eighteen points of damage.
source_quote: Grygum casts Inflict Wounds on Princess Ebonmire, dealing eighteen points of damage.

subject: Zalthir's final attack on Princess Ebonmire
fact: Zalthir uses Shadow Step to teleport and attacks Princess Ebonmire, grappling her and dealing damage.
source_quote: Zalthir uses Shadow Step to teleport and attacks Princess Ebonmire, grappling her and dealing damage.

subject: Thorin kills Princess Ebonmire
fact: Thorin attacks and kills Princess Ebonmire.
source_quote: Thorin attacks and kills Princess Ebonmire.

subject: Daz kills Prince Livid
fact: Daz casts Magic Missile at Prince Livid, killing him.
source_quote: Daz casts Magic Missile at Prince Livid, killing him.

subject: Zalthir's Shadow Step to Pudding King
fact: Zalthir uses Shadow Step to teleport near the Pudding King.
source_quote: Zalthir uses Shadow Step to teleport near the Pudding King.

subject: Zalthir's grappling and stunning strike
fact: Zalthir attacks the Pudding King with advantage, dealing damage and grappling him. He attempts a stunning strike; the Pudding King fails the save, halving his speed and granting advantage on the next melee attack.
source_quote: Zalthir attacks the Pudding King with advantage, dealing damage and grappling him. He attempts a stunning strike; the Pudding King fails the save, halving his speed and granting advantage on the next melee attack.

subject: Zalthir's total damage to Pudding King
fact: Zalthir continues attacking with punches and Eldritch Claw damage from his tentacles, dealing a total of thirty-seven points of damage.
source_quote: Zalthir continues attacking with punches and Eldritch Claw damage from his tentacles, dealing a total of thirty-seven points of damage.

subject: Pudding King's final telepathic scream
fact: The Pudding King dissolves, screaming telepathically: 'Behold the true feast, the soul's final blend!'
source_quote: The Pudding King dissolves, screaming telepathically: 'Behold the true feast, the soul's final blend!'

subject: Juiblex's demonic declaration
fact: A demonic voice, possibly Juiblex himself, declares: 'You haven't won. I will be reborn. I will consume the banquet of the queen of the fungi, and I will grow.'
source_quote: A demonic voice, possibly Juiblex himself, declares: 'You haven't won. I will be reborn. I will consume the banquet of the queen of the fungi, and I will grow.'

subject: spellbook location
fact: A spellbook containing many spells was found in Princess Ebonmire's stomach.
source_quote: a spellbook containing many spells, which was in Princess Ebonmire's stomach

subject: Glabbagool's new perspective
fact: Glabbagool expresses excitement about his new ooze form, seeing it as an opportunity to be carried and experience the world differently.
source_quote: Glabbagool expresses excitement about his new ooze form, seeing it as an opportunity to be carried and experience the world differently.

subject: Glabbagool's suggestion for containment
fact: Glabbagool suggests he could be carried in a jar or the Bag of Holding and serve as a garbage disposal.
source_quote: Glabbagool suggests he could be carried in a jar or the Bag of Holding and serve as a garbage disposal.

subject: party discusses Glabbagool's monk training
fact: The party discusses Glabbagool's potential monk training.
source_quote: The party discusses Glabbagool's potential monk training.
